scripts.report: npm run report:generate && allure open allure-report
scripts.report:html: npm run report:html:generate && npm run report:html:open
scripts.report:html:generate: node -e "require('fs').rmSync('allure-report',{recursive:true,force:true})" && set ALLURE_SINGLE_FILE=1&& allure generate allure-results -o allure-report
scripts.report:clear: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); for (const dir of ['allure-report','allure-results']) { fs.rmSync(dir,{recursive:true,force:true}); fs.mkdirSync(dir,{recursive:true}); }"
scripts.test:allure: npm test && npm run report:generate && npm run report:open
